story: WriteUp: 16 Bytes of x86 that turn Matrix rain into sound
text: My most favourite demo is "Freespin" which runs entirely on a floppy drive without a computer. Crazy stuff. [VIDEO]
Here's a demo running directly on the 1541 disk drive. It generates video by hacking the serial cable that's usually used to connect to the computer, and audio from the drive motors. [VIDEO]

See also: [LINK] -- [VIDEO] A demo, including music and graphics, written for the 1541 disk drive -- no, it is not a C64 demo, it runs entirely on the 1541 (which has a 6502 CPU and some amount of RAM in it)
